messages:
maya: Did an nsys+perfetto capture on the latency blip this morning. Pattern is consistent: when batch_count crosses ~48->50 we see cuBLASLt flip algos and workspace grows ~1MB -> ~2.5MB, and midbatch KV-cache evictions line up with the slow kernel launches.
liam: Can you paste the timeline snippet or the nsys kernel list?
sasha: Quick Q: are dims changing or just batch_count?
maya: Dims stable: M=1024 N=1024 K=512. It's the batch_count bump that correlates. Perfetto slice:
```
[00:00:00.120] cuBLASLtMatmul  algo=3  ws=1.0MB  dur=0.8ms
[00:00:00.128] cuBLASLtMatmul  algo=11 ws=2.45MB dur=3.0ms  <-- big jump
[00:00:00.132] kvcache_lookup  hit
[00:00:00.133] kvcache_evict   triggered during algo=11
```
liam: Algo 11 picks larger workspace; looks like probe decided that one. We turned on probing in last release (0.9.12) right?
jorge: Yep. Our probe picks per-shape but currently key is (M,N,K,device,prec). If probe ran when free_mem was high it might pick the big-ws algo and then subsequent batches get evicted.
maya: I dug into memo logic: we memoize after successful probe, but we don't include transient free memory info. So probe result can be ephemeral.
sasha: Two mitigation thoughts: 1) penalize algos by ws size in the latency heuristic, or 2) include a coarse occupancy bucket in the memo key so probe results depend on free-memory bucket.
liam: I like occupancy buckets. Less brittle than hard thresholds and lets the big-ws algo win when GPU truly idle.
maya: Proposed bucket: floor(free_bytes / 64MB). Add bucket into memo key as `memo_key = (M,N,K,device,prec,bucket)`. Cheap and captures ephemeral state.
jorge: Also add NVTX around probe and record chosen algo+ws so we can filter traces easily.
ops: Repro steps on rdx-gpu3:
```bash
export REDWOOD_PROBE=1
python bench_matmul.py --M 1024 --N 1024 --K 512 --batches 60
nsys profile -o /tmp/trace --trace=cuda,cublas python bench_matmul.py
```
maya: I'll push a small change: bucketed memoization + NVTX markers + a short log line. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/3129
perf-bot: nsys trace uploaded: https://perf.redwood/internal/trace-2468123456.html
liam: Two experiments: A) deploy bucketed memoization and collect p50/p95 on canary traffic; B) try a ws-penalty in the selection heuristic and compare unit cost.
sasha: I'll run the perf harness for A and post numbers here.
jorge: If eviction persists we can limit probe frequency (e.g., don't probe more than once per 5s for the same shape) or reserve a tiny slab during probe to avoid stealing KV cache space midbatch.
maya: Added metrics to Console: `algo_choice`, `algo_ws_bytes`, `probe_bucket`, and `kvcache_evictions` so we can correlate.
ops: If A looks good, we can roll to a dedicated canary for 24h and monitor evict/miss rates.
maya: Thanks all. I'll attach perfetto screenshots and p50/p95 numbers once perf-harness finishes.
